data.title: Pulsestat
data.subtitle: At-home cardiac monitoring, with a clinician in the loop
data.author: Pulsestat team

data.title: Arrhythmia is found too late
data.body: One in four adults over 60 develops a clinically actionable arrhythmia. Today, most cases are caught during a routine ECG — sometimes months after the first symptom.

data.title: A 7-day patch, read by a cardiologist
data.body: Pulsestat pairs a low-irritation wearable patch with a clinician-reviewed dashboard. The patient gets a real diagnosis, not a fitness-trend guess.

data.title: What we've seen in the first 1,200 patients
Closing a $4M extension
data.body: To scale the patch manufacturing line and to add two clinical sites in the Gulf.
